extensionDescription.message: Save bookmarks to your Cloudmark collection with one click.

unsupportedTabDetail.message: Only http:// and https:// pages are supported; you can paste another URL below.

baseUrlInvalid.message: Enter a valid http:// or https:// Cloudmark server URL.
